series.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago via ALFRED/FRED
series.historical_source: ALFRED NFCI vintage response, weekly ending Friday
series.revision_behavior: FRED warns that the series is subject to revision; an ALFRED real-time period is required for a historical as-of view.
series.publication_semantics: ALFRED vintage date identifies the real-time period requested, not an intraday release timestamp. FRED release-date documentation warns that source release dates do not necessarily equal website availability.
series.market_close_semantics: Not a market-close series; observation is weekly ending Friday and should not be treated as a Friday-morning value.
series.vintage_support: ALFRED CSV supports a selected vintage_date and the FRED page identifies weekly ending Friday frequency.
series.candidate_available_at_rule: For a row with an archived ALFRED vintage_date, set available_at = vintage_date 00:00 UTC + 1 calendar day (conservative publication delay); never use the same-day morning value. Existing rows without a per-vintage raw response remain proxy.

evidence.claim: Chicago Fed source and weekly ending Friday frequency.
ALFRED real-time periods represent information known by a past period.
Published source release dates do not necessarily represent availability on FRED/ALFRED, motivating the conservative delay.
The API documents vintage_dates for retrieving history as of selected dates.
